title: Week 12: G5 Performers of the Week
parts:
🔭 WEEK 12: G5 PERFORMERS OF THE WEEK

The best Group of 5 fantasy lines from Alpha Draft Signal prospects (Fantrax pts; QB/RB yds = total yds) 👇

Delaware QB Nick Minicucci had the #3 line of the week, P4 included.

🎯 QB
• Nick Minicucci (Delaware, SR): 395 yds, 5 TD (46.7)
• Blake Baker (La. Tech, SR): 338 yds, 5 TD (46.5)
• Hauss Hejny (Colorado St., JR): 486 yds, 4 TD (46.5)

🏃 RB
• A. Blue (EMU, SO): 176 yds, 3 TD (41.6)
• J. Carter (Memphis, SO): 229 yds, 3 TD (40.9)

🙌 WR
• Oran Singleton Jr. (Tulsa): 7-116-3 (37.7)
• Mario Sanders II (Southern Miss): 7-143-2 (33.3)
• Anthony Eager (South Alabama, SR): 8-102-2 (30.2)

🧱 TE
• Scott Moore (Delaware, SO): 4-54-3 (30.4)
• Leon Haughton Jr. (Old Dominion): 7-62-2 (30.4)

Jaylin Carter set a season high with 229 rush yds in Memphis' 38-34 loss at Navy. He's the #85 RB in the Alpha Draft Signal (preseason: #265).

Hauss Hejny's 413 pass yds were a season high. He's the #13 QB.

Which G5 name do you want on your devy roster? 👇
